title: 新同事入职第一天：看清 Welcome 项目和求助对象
topic: 新同事入职第一天：看清 Welcome 项目和求助对象

source.title: Getting Started
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 本课完整呈现 37signals 员工手册 Chapter 1: Getting Started，练习重点放在经理负责早期项目、Ops 协助账户设置，以及按岗位定制 Welcome 项目待办清单。练习人物和具体账号问题为虚构情境。
paragraphs: Getting started at 37signals involves a lot of little details, a number of big tasks, learning the details of your new job, meeting new coworkers, all while working remotely. Your teammates, your manager, your 37signals buddy, your Ops buddy, and our People team are all here to help as you navigate your first few days and weeks.

Before you start, the People team will order you a new computer with the specs you request and any accessories you need like an external keyboard, mouse, or display. Get what you need, while keeping in mind the demands of your work when choosing specs. Everyone working on ops, SIP, or writing Ruby for product should be running Omarchy. Everyone else are invited to run either Omarchy or a Mac.

A day or two before you start, your manager will email you instructions for your first day. Your manager will be your point of contact for your early projects and activities. You’ll also work with a member of our Ops team who will help you as you set up all the accounts you need to work at 37signals.

On your first day, you’ll log into Basecamp to see a project dedicated to your onboarding called “Welcome, [your name]!”. Your welcome project will contain a few to-do lists, tailored to your role and linking to accounts or services that you need to set up. You’ll also see to-do lists that your Ops buddy and manager will be working through. Your Ops buddy and your manager will be in contact with you as you set up your environment, should you have questions or get stuck.

Your training schedules and onboarding expectations will be in your welcome project. You’ll also find docs with helpful links to technical documentation, walkthrough videos, important Basecamp projects, and more.
Your welcome project will also contain a list of people to meet over the course of your first few weeks.
Your manager. You and your manager will meet on your first day to sort out a recurring 1:1 schedule and to review your specific onboarding expectations.
Your team. Most teams have a weekly call which you’ll join your first week.

Your 37signals buddy. Your buddy will be someone who’s not on your immediate team, who’s worked at 37signals for a while, and who can point you in the right direction when you have a question and don’t quite know where to turn. They’ll introduce themselves during your first week, to say hi and offer their help. They’ll check in with you periodically throughout your first couple months to see how you’re settling in.
People Ops. You’ll meet with Andrea to review 37signals policies, benefits, and compensation.

After your environment has been set up, expectations are clear, and you’ve met who you need to meet, you’ll get to work! You’ll begin working on real projects, with plenty of support and guidance, within your first week. Your responsibilities and impact will increase as you learn and gain confidence over the next few months, and most people are up to speed and feeling fully part of the team in about 3 months.
translations: 在 37signals 开始工作会涉及许多琐碎细节和重要任务；你需要熟悉新岗位、认识新同事，同时还要远程工作。团队同事、经理、37signals buddy、Ops buddy 和 People 团队都会帮助你度过入职的头几天和几周。
开始工作前，People 团队会按你的要求订购新电脑及所需配件，例如外接键盘、鼠标或显示器。选择配置时，既要满足需求，也要考虑工作要求。从事 ops、SIP 或为产品编写 Ruby 的员工应使用 Omarchy；其他人可以使用 Omarchy 或 Mac。
入职前一两天，经理会通过邮件发送第一天的安排。经理是你早期项目和活动的联系人。你还会与一名 Ops 团队成员合作，由对方帮助设置你在 37signals 工作所需的账户。
第一天登录 Basecamp 后，你会看到一个专门用于入职的项目，名为“Welcome, [你的姓名]!”。项目里有几个按岗位定制的待办清单，并链接到你需要设置的账户或服务。你也会看到 Ops buddy 和经理各自要处理的待办清单。设置工作环境时若有问题或遇到困难，Ops buddy 和经理会与你联系。
培训安排和入职预期会放在 Welcome 项目里。你还会找到有用链接文档，包括技术文档、操作演示视频、重要的 Basecamp 项目等。
Welcome 项目还会列出你在入职最初几周需要认识的人。
你的经理。第一天你会和经理安排固定的一对一沟通时间，并了解针对你的具体入职预期。
你的团队。大多数团队每周会开一次电话会议，你会在入职第一周参加。
你的 37signals buddy。对方不在你的直接团队，且在 37signals 工作了一段时间；当你有问题、不知道该找谁时，对方可以指引你。对方会在第一周介绍自己并表示愿意帮忙，最初几个月也会不时跟进，了解你的适应情况。
People Ops。你会与 Andrea 会面，了解 37signals 的政策、福利和薪酬。
工作环境设置完成、预期清楚、该认识的人也见过之后，你就会开始工作。第一周内你会在充分支持和指导下参与真实项目。随着熟悉工作并建立信心，接下来几个月你的职责和影响力会逐步增加；大多数人大约三个月后能跟上工作，并真正融入团队。

notes.explain: 说明遇到早期项目或工作活动问题时，应先联系谁。这里特指经理。
notes.example: Your manager is your point of contact for early projects.

notes.explain: 待办清单会按岗位调整，不表示每位新人收到完全相同的清单。
notes.example: The Welcome project has to-do lists tailored to your role.

notes.explain: set up 在此指完成账户配置，使其可用于工作。
notes.example: An Ops teammate can help you set up your work accounts.

notes.explain: 遇到问题无法继续时，可向 Ops buddy 或经理求助。
notes.example: If you get stuck, contact your Ops buddy or manager.

scenario.title: A new remote teammate cannot finish setting up work accounts
english: A new teammate has opened their Welcome project but is unsure which tasks apply to their role.
They also cannot finish setting up one of the work accounts and have a question about an early project.
You explain where to find the role-specific checklist and who can help with each question.
chinese: 一位远程新同事打开了自己的 Welcome 项目，但不确定哪些待办适用于其岗位。
他还无法完成一个工作账户的设置，并对早期项目有疑问。
你说明去哪里查看岗位清单，以及不同问题分别可以找谁帮忙。

firstAttempt.prompt: 新同事第一天找不到适合自己岗位的入职任务，工作账户也设置不完，还想问一个早期项目的问题。请用英文说明去哪里查看待办、账户找谁帮忙、早期项目找谁对接；如果卡住了怎么办。
firstAttempt.sample: Open your “Welcome, [your name]!” project and check the to-do lists tailored to your role. An Ops teammate can help you set up your work accounts. Your manager is your point of contact for early projects. If you get stuck while setting up your environment, contact your Ops buddy or manager.
firstAttempt.rationale: 回答需分别指出岗位待办的位置、账户设置的 Ops 支持、早期项目的经理联系人，并说明遇到困难时可联系 Ops buddy 或经理。

words.collocation: point of contact for a project
words.example: Your manager is your point of contact for early projects.
words.translation: 经理是你早期项目的对接人。
words.note: 用于说明某类事务由谁负责对接。

words.example: The Welcome project has to-do lists tailored to your role.
words.translation: Welcome 项目里有按你岗位定制的待办清单。
words.note: tailored to 后接被考虑的对象或需求。

words.example: Ops will help you set up the accounts you need for work.
words.translation: Ops 会帮你设置工作所需的账户。
words.note: 这里表示完成配置，让账户可以使用。

words.example: If you get stuck while setting up your environment, contact your Ops buddy or manager.
words.translation: 如果设置工作环境时遇到困难，可以联系 Ops buddy 或经理。
words.note: 说明遇到困难无法顺利继续，不是设备真的卡住。

structure.original: Your manager will be your point of contact for your early projects and activities.
analysis: Your manager 是主语，will be 是系动词结构。
your point of contact 是表语，说明经理承担的角色。
for your early projects and activities 限定对接范围：入职早期的项目和活动。
structure.transfer: If you cannot access a work account, ask Ops for setup help. For a question about your first project, contact your manager.

rewrite.bad: Ask your manager to set up every work account and choose your first project tasks.
rewrite.good: Check the to-do lists tailored to your role in your Welcome project. An Ops teammate can help you set up your work accounts, and your manager is your point of contact for early projects.
rewrite.translation: 查看 Welcome 项目中按你岗位定制的待办清单。Ops 团队成员可以帮你设置工作账户；经理是你早期项目的对接人。
rewrite.pattern: Check [the role-specific to-do list]. Ask [Ops] for help with [account setup], and contact [your manager] about [an early project].

cloze.prompt: The Welcome project has to-do lists tailored ___ your role.
cloze.why: 固定搭配是 tailored to，表示“按你的岗位定制”。

cloze.prompt: Your manager is your point of contact ___ early projects.
cloze.why: point of contact for + 事项，说明联系人负责对接哪类问题。

cloze.prompt: Ops can help you set ___ your work accounts.
cloze.why: set up an account 表示设置、配置账户。

dictation.text: Your manager will be your point of contact for your early projects and activities.
dictation.label: 听写 1 · 早期项目找谁
dictation.why: 听清 point of contact for 后面的对接事项。

dictation.text: Your welcome project will contain a few to-do lists, tailored to your role and linking to accounts or services that you need to set up.
dictation.label: 听写 2 · 岗位清单与账户
dictation.why: 辨认 tailored to your role 和 linking to accounts 两处关键信息。

apply.prompt: 新同事问岗位待办在哪里，且工作账户不会设置。请说明去哪里查看清单、找谁处理账户。
apply.sample: Check the to-do lists tailored to your role in your Welcome project. An Ops teammate can help you set up your work accounts.

translationPractice.prompt: Welcome 项目里有按你岗位定制的待办清单。
translationPractice.answer: The Welcome project has to-do lists tailored to your role.
translationPractice.why: tailored to your role 表示清单会根据具体岗位调整。

translationPractice.prompt: 经理是你早期项目的对接人。
translationPractice.answer: Your manager is your point of contact for early projects.
translationPractice.why: point of contact for 用来说明联系人负责对接的事项。

translationPractice.prompt: Ops 团队成员可以帮你设置工作账户。
translationPractice.answer: An Ops teammate can help you set up your work accounts.

choice.prompt: 新同事第一天找不到适合自己岗位的入职任务，工作账户也设置不完，还想问一个早期项目的问题。请用英文说明去哪里查看待办、账户找谁帮忙、早期项目找谁对接；如果卡住了怎么办。
options: Ask your manager to configure all accounts, assign your role-specific tasks, and answer every question about Ops systems.

Open your “Welcome, [your name]!” project for the role-specific to-do lists. Ask Ops for account setup help, and contact your manager about early projects. If you get stuck, contact your Ops buddy or manager.
Skip the Welcome project and start any available task. Account setup can wait until your first project is finished.
choice.why: 正确项把 Welcome 项目、Ops 的账户设置支持和经理的早期项目对接职责分开，也说明遇到困难时的求助对象。

output.prompt: 一位远程新同事已经登录 Basecamp，但找不到下一步清单；他也无法打开一个工作服务，还想确认首个项目的要求。请用英文分别告诉他看哪里、账户问题找谁、项目问题找谁，并说明遇到困难可以怎么办。
output.sample: Open your “Welcome, [your name]!” project and check the to-do lists tailored to your role. An Ops teammate can help you set up access to the work service. Your manager is your point of contact for the first project. If you get stuck, contact your Ops buddy or manager.
